title: Authorize CP11d Historical Integrity relocation
goal: Pre-authorize the exact move, trusted-base and policy/config tuples for the Post-stage Historical Integrity relocation.
acceptanceCriteria: The move authorization covers only the complete legacy and stage-owned Historical Integrity trees.
The trusted-base authorization binds the exact changed TCB paths and required validation suite.
The weaken-policy authorization binds every semantic configuration change reported by the base registry.
The authorization-only change modifies no trusted component or production policy.
The relocation candidate consumes all three records in the same protected diff.
